shots.action: A majestic cyberpunk starship breaking through dense neon cloud cover above a megacity
shots.lighting: Cinematic volumetric neon cyan and magenta
shots.narration_line: In the dawn of a new centuries, Humanity touched the stars.

shots.action: Interior cockpit view: Captain V staring intently at holographic stellar navigation chart

characters.name: Captain V
characters.description: cyborg commander in sleek metallic jacket

shots.narration_line: Every signal mapped, every quantum pulse calculated.

shots.action: Massive hyper-jump engine core igniting with radiant golden plasma energy
shots.narration_line: The warp engine awakened, bending space and time.

shots.narration_line: GenOTT V2. The future of autonomous AI filmmaking.
